text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I won......... I... in this Tokyo 
Daishoten...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-e-e!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, total and utter defeat!! Huge 
congratulations, Tarumae!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey... thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm the one who should thank you☆ 
Because during the race, I saw it! A sign 
like never before...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is a future where we bring out the 
best in each other, elevating ourselves to 
limitless heights...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae! I'm going to challenge you again! 
Let's run together as many times as it 
takes!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because that will surely become a path of 
light and break through our limits!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Is this supposed to be your challenge to 
me, Ricky? Heh, bring it on. I'll take you 
on as many times as it takes!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“—Tarumae-chan, congratulations. You're a 
true champion, aren't you?”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It was because you were always running 
ahead of me, Acute-san, that I was able to 
make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu— You're very welcome~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess I'll have to keep competing with 
Tarumae-chan for a long time yet."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Since Ricky-chan came all this way too, 
it'd be a waste not to have even more 
fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Let's keep running together, 
on and on!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because we are the brilliance born from 
the dirt!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaann!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...So that was it after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I'm home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Hokko Tarumae!! Tarumae 
is the undisputed dirt champion!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were shining out thereーー!!! Thank 
you for the best race everーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!! Thank you for cheering me on!! 
Once again—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The star born in Tomakomai!! A migratory 
bird with paper wings!! I'm Hokko 
Tarumae!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can stand here today is all 
thanks to everyone who cheered for me, and 
to those who raised me—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A "hometown," and—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to every single one of the 
amazing dirt Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to support me!! Dirt 
racing!! And Tomakomai!! From now on as 
well— Thank you so much!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

The cheers celebrating Hokko Tarumae 
echoed long into the skies over Oi 
Racecourse—
And so, a short time passed...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Next up for Hokko Tarumae's 'URA Best 
Dirt Umamusume' commemorative event is the 
bouquet presentation!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if it's a URA award, why is the 
commemorative event at Oi Racecourse? Oi 
counts as regional, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Obviously it's because Tarumae hyped up 
dirt racing this year, regardless of 
whether it was Central or Local!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Here is our guest presenter! Having just 
announced her official return to the 
stage, it's Smart Falcon-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Tarumae-chan!! You shone 
so brilliantly out there!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Falco-san—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't make it in time for the Tokyo 
Daishoten, but we're definitely gonna run 
together!! I'm more fired up than I've 
ever been before!!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so, so much— for making me feel 
this way!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, it's me who should be... Thank you so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because Falco-san was there for me, I'm 
sure I...—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Then... right at this moment, we're even ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Tarumae-chan. There is something I want 
to entrust to you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Something you want to entrust to me...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The thing I could never achieve, a victory 
in an international GⅠ race in Dubai for 
dirt Umamusume, that's what☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if they'll accept it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's just—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Isn't the answer already obvious?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll show the world the 
brilliance of Japanese dirt and 
Tomakomai...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tarumae-chan—

Beneath a deluge of thunderous applause, a 
brand-new challenge was being born—
